testcase.name: Scenario: Switch between the basic wheel layouts: tmp/obk-wheel-size-3943-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:23:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch between the basic wheel layouts ✔ Given the full navigation wheel is open over a visible model in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Basic View Object Wheel ✔ Then the wheel shows Center, Zoom, Rewind and Orbit controls ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel ✔ Then Basic View Object Wheel is marked as the selected layout ✔ When the user chooses Basic Tour Building Wheel ✔ Then the wheel shows Forward, Look, Rewind and Up Down controls ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel ✔ Then Basic Tour Building Wheel is marked as the selected layout ✔ When the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel disappears ✔ And the model remains visible in the same apparent view ✔ And the status area displays Ready
